description: Hi! I'm Hrishan Patil, CEO of Crew Platina. We're competing in the NASA Space Apps Challenge in Folsom, taking on the Earth Information Jukebox challenge. We're looking for creative and motivated people interested in coding, AI, web development, data science, design, or Earth science. Experience is great, but enthusiasm and fresh ideas matter more! We value teamwork, creativity, and learning together. Let's build something innovative and make this experience count. Join Crew Platina! 🚀

details:
Earth Info Jukebox : Project Details

Our project, Earth Info Jukebox, is an interactive app that uses sound to help people understand different phenomena related to Earth. The app works by using different sound frequencies and pitches to represent information, with lower-pitched sounds conveying certain phenomena. Users can interact with the app and learn about Earth through listening rather than relying only on reading text or looking at images.

One major benefit of our project is that it makes learning about Earth more engaging, creative, and accessible. It provides a different way to process information and helps users connect sounds to real-world environmental concepts. Our intended impact is to encourage curiosity about Earth's natural phenomena and show how technology can make science education more interactive.

We developed our project using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. HTML provided the structure of our app, CSS helped us design its appearance and layout, and JavaScript allowed us to add interactive features and functionality.

Our project is creative because it combines science, technology, and sound to create a unique learning experience. Instead of presenting information in traditional ways, we turned Earth-related phenomena into an auditory experience. Throughout development, our team considered how different pitches could communicate information, how users would interact with the app, and how to make the experience understandable and enjoyable. Overall, Earth Info Jukebox demonstrates how sound and technology can create new and exciting ways to explore our planet.
